question: What is the primary definition of a computer network?
options: A collection of autonomous computing devices connected together to share data and resources
A standalone supercomputer executing multiple background threads without external connections
A single display monitor connected directly to multiple local video input cables
A software compiler that translates high-level code into machine instructions
answer: A collection of autonomous computing devices connected together to share data and resources

What is the primary functional difference between Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) and User Datagram Protocol (UDP)?
options: TCP is connection-oriented and reliable, while UDP is connectionless and unacknowledged
UDP provides guaranteed delivery with acknowledgments, while TCP drops lost packets
TCP operates only at the Network layer, while UDP operates at the Physical layer
UDP encrypts all payload data automatically, while TCP sends plaintext data
answer: TCP is connection-oriented and reliable, while UDP is connectionless and unacknowledged

What is the primary function of the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP)?
options: To map a known IP address to a physical MAC address on a local network

question: Which network device operates at Layer 2 to divide a network into multiple collision domains while maintaining a single broadcast domain?
Why is an Ethernet switch more efficient than an Ethernet hub?
options: A switch inspects MAC addresses to forward frames only to the designated recipient port

A switch eliminates the need for physical cabling by using radio waves

answer: A switch inspects MAC addresses to forward frames only to the designated recipient port
